detail.longDescription: "The lawsuit, filed in Federal District Court in Massachusetts, seeks to block the N.S.F. from dismantling its social science funding division, known as the Directorate for Social, Behavioral and Economic Sciences. The division is “dedicated to understanding human behavior and improving people’s quality of life,”..., and it typically funds research in topics ranging from brain mapping to economics." https://www. nytimes.com/2026/11/09/us/poli tics/national-science-foundation-funding-lawsuit.html # SocialScience # grants # research # funding # courts # USpol
